title: Pick how to light it
kid_text: Pick the easiest way to light it.
safety: Do not start a flame until the nest is ready.

steps.text: Use a lighter if you have one.
Use a ferro rod if you have one.
Use matches if you have them.
Use the sun only when the sky is bright.
A cell and steel wool can make heat.
A bow drill works with no tool.

mistakes.text: You skip a lighter and start a drill.
mistakes.fix: Use the easiest tool you have.

mistakes.text: The nest is not built yet.
